notes.title: STAGE 2: THE TUNNELS AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
[b]Dear player[/b],

Damage Control Studios is presenting you with a late week gift! Our first [b]HUGE update[/b] is now available for everyone! The new level, with some big improvements is now available. Mysteries of The Abyss awaits you!

[u]PATCH NOTES[/u]:

- [b]Stage 2: The Tunnel[/b]
- Save/load game
-Optimization improvement (system requirements lowered)
- Some Minor Bug Fixes
